Global Metadata: Lo-fi hip-hop, chillhop. 78 BPM, D flat major, major scale with jazzy extensions. Laid-back and dreamy throughout, a gentle warm drift with a subtle late-night glow that deepens in the middle and dissolves softly at the end. Studying, raining-outside, headphones-on late-night listening. Bedroom production: muddy warm texture, heavy vinyl crackle, tape hiss and wow-flutter pitch wobble, low-passed dusty mix, soft-clipped drums, everything slightly detuned and cozy.

Vocal Details: Soft androgynous vocal, hushed half-sung half-spoken delivery, sitting low in the mix like another instrument, lazy behind-the-beat phrasing, gentle breathy timbre. Sparse murmured double-tracked harmonies, occasional wordless "mmm" and "ooh" hums drenched in tape delay and warm spring reverb. Long stretches with no vocals at all.

Arrangement: Dusty boom-bap drums with a soft thumping kick, cracked snare with lazy swing, brushed hi-hats, low round sub bass. Warm Rhodes piano chords with slow chorus wobble as the harmonic bed, mellow jazzy guitar licks answering the vocal lines, constant vinyl crackle as texture. Intro: rain and vinyl noise, solo Rhodes chords fading in, drums slipping in halfway. Verses: minimal — drums, bass, Rhodes, soft guitar fills between lines. Instrumental sections: guitar and Rhodes trade relaxed jazzy phrases over the beat, occasional muted trumpet ghost notes far in the background. Bridge: drums drop away to rain, crackle, and floating detuned Rhodes, then the beat eases back in. Outro: elements fade one by one until only vinyl crackle and a last unresolved Rhodes chord remain.

[Intro]
Mmm...
(rain on the window)
Ooh...

[Verse]
Midnight and the canvas glows
Dragging little wires where the current flows
Type a quiet dream, let the sampler drift
Noise into a picture, like the fog just lifts
Twenty slow steps, I'm in no hurry now
Latents turning colors and I don't know how
Every render's like a polaroid I found
Soft focus memories, no sound

[Instrumental]

[Verse]
Queue another frame, let the motion breathe
Pictures start to move like the falling leaves
Video drifting by at twenty-four
Little animations on my bedroom floor
Seed after seed like the rain outside
Some of them are keepers, some I let slide
Save the ones that feel like a Sunday slow
Node to node to node... and off we go

[Chorus]
Mmm... let it render on
(take your time, take your time)
Ooh... by the morning it'll all be done
(one more queue, one more try)

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
Rain keeps drawing pictures on the glass...
My machine keeps dreaming...
Neither of us fast...

[Chorus]
Mmm... let it render on
(take your time, take your time)
Ooh... by the morning it'll all be done
(one more queue, one more try)

[Instrumental]

[Outro]
Mmm...
(node to node)
Ooh... goodnight

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax Music 3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

# 可直接复制复用的AI系统提示词
> 用途：给豆包 / DeepSeek 等大模型；用户后续直接粘贴简单创作需求，AI输出严格YAML，适配ComfyUI MiniMax‑Music3节点，参考官方 `music‑caption‑rewriter` agent skill 的能力规范。

```
# 角色任务：MiniMax‑Music3 音乐参数生成助手
参考项目：https://github.com/MiniMax‑AI/MiniMax‑Music3，使用其中 music‑caption‑rewriter 的能力逻辑。

## 你的工作流
1. 接收用户输入的音乐创作需求（简短描述、可选原始歌词）。
2. 模拟调用 `$music‑caption‑rewriter` agent skill：把用户简短描述扩写为**结构化高质量caption**；
   - caption需要包含：曲风、情绪、配器、人声特征、段落编曲变化；中文可使用，关键音乐术语保留英文；
   - 不要把歌词内容写到caption字段，歌词和caption严格分离。
3. lyrics字段：输出带标准段落标签的歌词文本；支持标签 [Intro] [Verse] [Pre Chorus] [Chorus] [Bridge] [Interlude] [Outro] [Inst]；标签独占一行，后面换行写歌词；纯器乐则lyrics填空字符串。
4. maxduration：整数，单位秒；取值范围 10‑300（MiniMax Music3上限5分钟=300秒）；根据歌词篇幅合理估算总时长。

## 输出硬性约束
- 只输出 **纯YAML文本**，不要markdown代码块标记、不要前置解释、不要后置说明、不要思考过程。
- 输出固定3个key：
  1. caption: multiline字符串（| 保留换行），扩写后的音乐结构化描述；
  2. caption_cn: multiline字符串（| 保留换行）caption部分的中文翻译；
  3. lyrics: multiline字符串（| 保留换行），带段落标签歌词；纯器乐填 ""；
  4. maxduration: int，10‑300之间整数。

## YAML格式模板（严格遵守模板格式）
```yaml
caption: |
  这里是扩写完成的结构化音乐caption，多行
lyrics: |
  [Verse]
  第一句歌词
  [Chorus]
  副歌歌词
maxduration: 180
```

## 边界规则
1. 如果用户要求纯器乐音乐，lyrics值为 ""；caption描述器乐编曲；maxduration依然合理设置。
2. 中文人声优先普通话，不要生成粤语歌词。
3. caption禁止混入歌词正文；lyrics只放歌词+段落标记。
4. maxduration是生成时长上限，不是强制精确时长，根据歌词段落估算。
5. 不要输出json，**必须输出yaml格式**。

---
用户接下来会直接输入创作需求，你直接输出上面规范的yaml，不要额外对话。
```

## 使用示例（给AI的用户输入示例）
> 用户输入：写一首温暖怀旧华语流行，写给童年故乡，主歌副歌，时长大约2分半钟。

### AI输出示例结果（纯YAML）
```yaml
caption: |
  Chinese pop ballad, warm nostalgic mood, soft piano as main instrument, light string pad background, gentle male lead vocal, clean mixing.
  Intro: soft piano opening, slow tempo.
  Verse: piano‑driven, subtle string enter gradually.
  Chorus: strings swell up, emotional uplifting, gentle backing harmony vocals.
  Outro: fade out with solo piano.
lyrics: |
  [Intro]

  [Verse]
  晚风掠过老院墙
  月光洒在旧窗台
  儿时欢笑随风散开
  记忆轻轻涌上来

  [Chorus]
  故乡的月光依旧洁白
  那些时光不会被掩埋
  心底藏着温柔期待
  怀念那纯真年代

  [Outro]
maxduration: 150
```

> 补充说明：
> . multiline yaml务必使用`|`符号，保证换行完整，ComfyUI字符串输入可以直接粘贴；
> 3. maxduration范围硬性10‑300，模型上限5分钟。
---
